articles.title: NFL Draft 2026: Leaning in at DT & CB in Packers 7-round mock
articles.summary: As Draft week progresses, football analysts are actively engaged in submitting their final mock drafts for the upcoming 2026 NFL Draft. This particular piece details one writer's participation in this annual tradition, outlining their predictions and analysis of potential player selections for various teams. This reflects the intense anticipation and strategic planning within American professional football.
